            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">

<h2 class="XYd-Qa_Headline PDq2pG_selectionAnchorContainer" data-w-component="title" data-w-weight="semibold" data-w-size="xl">第十六章 未来的大模型与 AI Agent：从模型竞争到系统竞争</h2>
<div class="duPRdW_Divider" data-w-component="divider">
<h2 class="PDq2pG_selectionAnchorContainer" data-section-id="1mpo7k2" data-start="613" data-end="633">目录</h2>
<p class="PDq2pG_selectionAnchorContainer" data-section-id="1mpo7k2" data-start="613" data-end="633"><a href="https://www.cnblogs.com/GuZhenYin/p/20983335">零基础认识大语言模型（LLM）工作原理目录 - GuZhenYin - 博客园</a></p>
</div>
<h2 class="XYd-Qa_Headline" data-w-component="title" data-w-weight="semibold" data-w-size="lg">本章导读</h2>
<p class="zlAe0W_TextBase zlAe0W_Text" data-w-component="text" data-w-wrap="normal">过去几年，AI 领域最受关注的指标往往是：</p>
<ul class="Ck6QPa_List" data-w-component="list" data-w-variant="native-unordered">
<li class="v9V1QG_Item" data-w-component="list-item">
<div class="ac5DTa_Box v9V1QG_Content" data-w-direction="col" data-w-auto-spacing="" data-w-list-content="">
<p class="zlAe0W_TextBase zlAe0W_Text" data-w-component="text" data-w-wrap="normal">参数量有多大；</p>
</div>
</li>
<li class="v9V1QG_Item" data-w-component="list-item">
<div class="ac5DTa_Box v9V1QG_Content" data-w-direction="col" data-w-auto-spacing="" data-w-list-content="">
<p class="zlAe0W_TextBase zlAe0W_Text" data-w-component="text" data-w-wrap="normal">上下文窗口有多长；</p>
</div>
</li>
<li class="v9V1QG_Item" data-w-component="list-item">
<div class="ac5DTa_Box v9V1QG_Content" data-w-direction="col" data-w-auto-spacing="" data-w-list-content="">
<p class="zlAe0W_TextBase zlAe0W_Text" data-w-component="text" data-w-wrap="normal">推理能力有多强；</p>
</div>
</li>
<li class="v9V1QG_Item" data-w-component="list-item">
<div class="ac5DTa_Box v9V1QG_Content" data-w-direction="col" data-w-auto-spacing="" data-w-list-content="">
<p class="zlAe0W_TextBase zlAe0W_Text" data-w-component="text" data-w-wrap="normal">排行榜成绩有多高。</p>
</div>
</li>
</ul>
<p class="zlAe0W_TextBase zlAe0W_Text" data-w-component="text" data-w-wrap="normal">这些指标当然还是很重要，因为它直接反映了模型本身的能力。<strong>(包括最新出来的kimi k3 参数已经达到了2.8万亿)</strong></p>
<p class="zlAe0W_TextBase zlAe0W_Text" data-w-component="text" data-w-wrap="normal">但是，当 AI 开始真正进入企业和软件系统之后，我们就逐渐发现：<strong><span class="zlAe0W_TextBase zlAe0W_Text rFU14q_Emphasis" data-w-component="bold" data-w-default-strong="" data-w-inline="" data-w-wrap="normal">仅仅拥有一个强大的模型，并不等于拥有一个真正有价值的 AI 系统。</span></strong></p>
<p class="zlAe0W_TextBase zlAe0W_Text" data-w-component="text" data-w-wrap="normal">人们实际需要的，通常不是“一个很会聊天的模型”，而是：</p>
<ul class="Ck6QPa_List" data-w-component="list" data-w-variant="native-unordered">
<li class="v9V1QG_Item" data-w-component="list-item">
<div class="ac5DTa_Box v9V1QG_Content" data-w-direction="col" data-w-auto-spacing="" data-w-list-content="">
<p class="zlAe0W_TextBase zlAe0W_Text" data-w-component="text" data-w-wrap="normal">能连接业务系统；</p>
</div>
</li>
<li class="v9V1QG_Item" data-w-component="list-item">
<div class="ac5DTa_Box v9V1QG_Content" data-w-direction="col" data-w-auto-spacing="" data-w-list-content="">
<p class="zlAe0W_TextBase zlAe0W_Text" data-w-component="text" data-w-wrap="normal">能读取企业知识；</p>
</div>
</li>
<li class="v9V1QG_Item" data-w-component="list-item">
<div class="ac5DTa_Box v9V1QG_Content" data-w-direction="col" data-w-auto-spacing="" data-w-list-content="">
<p class="zlAe0W_TextBase zlAe0W_Text" data-w-component="text" data-w-wrap="normal">能执行复杂流程；</p>
</div>
</li>
<li class="v9V1QG_Item" data-w-component="list-item">
<div class="ac5DTa_Box v9V1QG_Content" data-w-direction="col" data-w-auto-spacing="" data-w-list-content="">
<p class="zlAe0W_TextBase zlAe0W_Text" data-w-component="text" data-w-wrap="normal">能长期记住上下文；</p>
</div>
</li>
<li class="v9V1QG_Item" data-w-component="list-item">
<div class="ac5DTa_Box v9V1QG_Content" data-w-direction="col" data-w-auto-spacing="" data-w-list-content="">
<p class="zlAe0W_TextBase zlAe0W_Text" data-w-component="text" data-w-wrap="normal">能持续完成任务。</p>
</div>
</li>
</ul>
<p class="zlAe0W_TextBase zlAe0W_Text" data-w-component="text" data-w-wrap="normal">这其实标识着，<strong>AI 的竞争正在从“单一模型能力”逐渐转向“完整系统能力”。</strong></p>
<div class="duPRdW_Divider" data-w-component="divider">&nbsp;</div>
<h2 class="XYd-Qa_Headline" data-w-component="title" data-w-weight="semibold" data-w-size="xl">16.1 模型仍然重要，但已经不是全部</h2>
<p class="zlAe0W_TextBase zlAe0W_Text" data-w-component="text" data-w-wrap="normal">大语言模型依然是整个<strong> AI 系统的核心</strong>。</p>
<p class="zlAe0W_TextBase zlAe0W_Text" data-w-component="text" data-w-wrap="normal">因为它提供了：</p>
<ul class="Ck6QPa_List" data-w-component="list" data-w-variant="native-unordered">
<li class="v9V1QG_Item" data-w-component="list-item">
<div class="ac5DTa_Box v9V1QG_Content" data-w-direction="col" data-w-auto-spacing="" data-w-list-content="">
<p class="zlAe0W_TextBase zlAe0W_Text" data-w-component="text" data-w-wrap="normal">语言理解能力；</p>
</div>
</li>
<li class="v9V1QG_Item" data-w-component="list-item">
<div class="ac5DTa_Box v9V1QG_Content" data-w-direction="col" data-w-auto-spacing="" data-w-list-content="">
<p class="zlAe0W_TextBase zlAe0W_Text" data-w-component="text" data-w-wrap="normal">推理能力；</p>
</div>
</li>
<li class="v9V1QG_Item" data-w-component="list-item">
<div class="ac5DTa_Box v9V1QG_Content" data-w-direction="col" data-w-auto-spacing="" data-w-list-content="">
<p class="zlAe0W_TextBase zlAe0W_Text" data-w-component="text" data-w-wrap="normal">生成能力；</p>
</div>
</li>
<li class="v9V1QG_Item" data-w-component="list-item">
<div class="ac5DTa_Box v9V1QG_Content" data-w-direction="col" data-w-auto-spacing="" data-w-list-content="">
<p class="zlAe0W_TextBase zlAe0W_Text" data-w-component="text" data-w-wrap="normal">规划能力。</p>
</div>
</li>
</ul>
<p class="zlAe0W_TextBase zlAe0W_Text" data-w-component="text" data-w-wrap="normal"><strong>没有 LLM，后面的 Tool、Workflow、Memory、Agent 都失去了智能基础。</strong></p>
<p class="zlAe0W_TextBase zlAe0W_Text" data-w-component="text" data-w-wrap="normal">但是，LLM 更像是：<strong><span class="zlAe0W_TextBase zlAe0W_Text rFU14q_Emphasis" data-w-component="bold" data-w-default-strong="" data-w-inline="" data-w-wrap="normal">AI 系统中的“大脑”。</span></strong></p>
<p class="zlAe0W_TextBase zlAe0W_Text" data-w-component="text" data-w-wrap="normal">然而一个真正能够工作的智能体，还需要：</p>
<ul class="Ck6QPa_List" data-w-component="list" data-w-variant="native-unordered">
<li class="v9V1QG_Item" data-w-component="list-item">
<div class="ac5DTa_Box v9V1QG_Content" data-w-direction="col" data-w-auto-spacing="" data-w-list-content="">
<p class="zlAe0W_TextBase zlAe0W_Text" data-w-component="text" data-w-wrap="normal">感知外部世界；</p>
</div>
</li>
<li class="v9V1QG_Item" data-w-component="list-item">
<div class="ac5DTa_Box v9V1QG_Content" data-w-direction="col" data-w-auto-spacing="" data-w-list-content="">
<p class="zlAe0W_TextBase zlAe0W_Text" data-w-component="text" data-w-wrap="normal">调用工具执行动作；</p>
</div>
</li>
<li class="v9V1QG_Item" data-w-component="list-item">
<div class="ac5DTa_Box v9V1QG_Content" data-w-direction="col" data-w-auto-spacing="" data-w-list-content="">
<p class="zlAe0W_TextBase zlAe0W_Text" data-w-component="text" data-w-wrap="normal">保存长期记忆；</p>
</div>
</li>
<li class="v9V1QG_Item" data-w-component="list-item">
<div class="ac5DTa_Box v9V1QG_Content" data-w-direction="col" data-w-auto-spacing="" data-w-list-content="">
<p class="zlAe0W_TextBase zlAe0W_Text" data-w-component="text" data-w-wrap="normal">管理任务状态；</p>
</div>
</li>
<li class="v9V1QG_Item" data-w-component="list-item">
<div class="ac5DTa_Box v9V1QG_Content" data-w-direction="col" data-w-auto-spacing="" data-w-list-content="">
<p class="zlAe0W_TextBase zlAe0W_Text" data-w-component="text" data-w-wrap="normal">协调多个能力模块。</p>
</div>
</li>
</ul>
<p class="zlAe0W_TextBase zlAe0W_Text" data-w-component="text" data-w-wrap="normal">因此,我认为&nbsp;<strong><span class="zlAe0W_TextBase zlAe0W_Text rFU14q_Emphasis" data-w-component="bold" data-w-default-strong="" data-w-inline="" data-w-wrap="normal">未来的 AI 应用，不是“只有模型”，而是“模型 + 系统”的组合。</span></strong></p>
<div class="duPRdW_Divider" data-w-component="divider">&nbsp;</div>
<h2 class="XYd-Qa_Headline" data-w-component="title" data-w-weight="semibold" data-w-size="xl">16.2 从 ChatBot 到 Agent：AI 应用形态的演进</h2>
<p class="zlAe0W_TextBase zlAe0W_Text" data-w-component="text" data-w-wrap="normal">我们可以把 AI 应用的发展过程理解为一个逐步升级的过程。</p>
<div class="relative w-full mt-4 mb-1">
<div class="contents">
<div class="relative">
<div class="h-full min-h-0 min-w-0">
<div class="h-full min-h-0 min-w-0">
<div class="border border-token-border-light border-radius-3xl corner-superellipse/1.1 rounded-3xl">
<div class="h-full w-full border-radius-3xl bg-(--code-block-surface) corner-superellipse/1.1 overflow-clip rounded-3xl [--code-block-surface:var(--bg-elevated-secondary)] dark:[--code-block-surface:var(--composer-surface-primary)] lxnfua_clipPathFallback">
<div class="relative">
<div class="pe-11 pt-3">
<div class="relative z-0 flex max-w-full">
<div id="code-block-viewer" class="q9tKkq_viewer cm-editor z-10 light:cm-light dark:cm-light flex h-full w-full flex-col items-stretch ͼd ͼr" dir="ltr">
<div class="cm-scroller">
<pre class="cm-content q9tKkq_readonly m-0"><code>ChatBot
    ↓
Tool Calling
    ↓
MCP
    ↓
Workflow
    ↓
Memory
    ↓
Skill
    ↓
Agent Runtime
    ↓
Autonomous Agent</code></pre>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<div>&nbsp;这个演进过程反映了 AI 从“回答问题”到“完成任务”的变化。</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>

<p class="zlAe0W_TextBase zlAe0W_Text" data-w-component="text" data-w-wrap="normal">连接统一工具生态</p>
</td>
</tr>
<tr class="oVf2pG_Row" data-w-component="table-row">

</td>
<td class="oVf2pG_Cell" data-w-component="table-cell" data-w-column-size="sm">

</td>
</tr>
<tr class="oVf2pG_Row" data-w-component="table-row">
<td class="oVf2pG_Cell" data-w-component="table-cell" data-w-column-size="sm">
<p class="zlAe0W_TextBase zlAe0W_Text" data-w-component="text" data-w-wrap="normal">Memory</p>
</td>
<td class="oVf2pG_Cell" data-w-component="table-cell" data-w-column-size="sm">
<p class="zlAe0W_TextBase zlAe0W_Text" data-w-component="text" data-w-wrap="normal">保存长期信息</p>
</td>
</tr>
<tr class="oVf2pG_Row" data-w-component="table-row">
<td class="oVf2pG_Cell" data-w-component="table-cell" data-w-column-size="sm">
<p class="zlAe0W_TextBase zlAe0W_Text" data-w-component="text" data-w-wrap="normal">Skill</p>
</td>
<td class="oVf2pG_Cell" data-w-component="table-cell" data-w-column-size="sm">
<p class="zlAe0W_TextBase zlAe0W_Text" data-w-component="text" data-w-wrap="normal">封装专业能力</p>
</td>
</tr>
<tr class="oVf2pG_Row" data-w-component="table-row">
<td class="oVf2pG_Cell" data-w-component="table-cell" data-w-column-size="sm">
<p class="zlAe0W_TextBase zlAe0W_Text" data-w-component="text" data-w-wrap="normal">Agent Runtime</p>
</td>
<td class="oVf2pG_Cell" data-w-component="table-cell" data-w-column-size="sm">
<p class="zlAe0W_TextBase zlAe0W_Text" data-w-component="text" data-w-wrap="normal">持续执行任务</p>
</td>
</tr>
<tr class="oVf2pG_Row" data-w-component="table-row">
<td class="oVf2pG_Cell" data-w-component="table-cell" data-w-column-size="sm">
<p class="zlAe0W_TextBase zlAe0W_Text" data-w-component="text" data-w-wrap="normal">Autonomous Agent</p>
</td>
<td class="oVf2pG_Cell" data-w-component="table-cell" data-w-column-size="sm">
<p class="zlAe0W_TextBase zlAe0W_Text" data-w-component="text" data-w-wrap="normal">自主规划和完成复杂目标</p>
</td>
</tr>

</div>
<p class="zlAe0W_TextBase zlAe0W_Text" data-w-component="text" data-w-wrap="normal">可以看到：<strong><span class="zlAe0W_TextBase zlAe0W_Text rFU14q_Emphasis" data-w-component="bold" data-w-default-strong="" data-w-inline="" data-w-wrap="normal">Agent 并不是突然出现的新概念，而是 AI 能力逐步工程化后的结果。</span></strong></p>
<p class="zlAe0W_TextBase zlAe0W_Text" data-w-component="text" data-w-wrap="normal">&nbsp;</p>
<h2 class="XYd-Qa_Headline" data-w-component="title" data-w-weight="semibold" data-w-size="xl">16.3 为什么未来比拼的是系统能力？</h2>
<p class="zlAe0W_TextBase zlAe0W_Text" data-w-component="text" data-w-wrap="normal">假设有两家公司。</p>
<p class="zlAe0W_TextBase zlAe0W_Text" data-w-component="text" data-w-wrap="normal">A 公司拥有一个很强的大模型，但它只能聊天。</p>
<p class="zlAe0W_TextBase zlAe0W_Text" data-w-component="text" data-w-wrap="normal">B 公司使用同样的大模型，但它还拥有：</p>
<ul class="Ck6QPa_List" data-w-component="list" data-w-variant="native-unordered">
<li class="v9V1QG_Item" data-w-component="list-item">
<div class="ac5DTa_Box v9V1QG_Content" data-w-direction="col" data-w-auto-spacing="" data-w-list-content="">
<p class="zlAe0W_TextBase zlAe0W_Text" data-w-component="text" data-w-wrap="normal">企业知识库；</p>
</div>
</li>
<li class="v9V1QG_Item" data-w-component="list-item">
<div class="ac5DTa_Box v9V1QG_Content" data-w-direction="col" data-w-auto-spacing="" data-w-list-content="">
<p class="zlAe0W_TextBase zlAe0W_Text" data-w-component="text" data-w-wrap="normal">数据库连接能力；</p>
</div>
</li>
<li class="v9V1QG_Item" data-w-component="list-item">
<div class="ac5DTa_Box v9V1QG_Content" data-w-direction="col" data-w-auto-spacing="" data-w-list-content="">
<p class="zlAe0W_TextBase zlAe0W_Text" data-w-component="text" data-w-wrap="normal">ERP 接口；</p>
</div>
</li>
<li class="v9V1QG_Item" data-w-component="list-item">
<div class="ac5DTa_Box v9V1QG_Content" data-w-direction="col" data-w-auto-spacing="" data-w-list-content="">
<p class="zlAe0W_TextBase zlAe0W_Text" data-w-component="text" data-w-wrap="normal">Workflow 流程；</p>
</div>
</li>
<li class="v9V1QG_Item" data-w-component="list-item">
<div class="ac5DTa_Box v9V1QG_Content" data-w-direction="col" data-w-auto-spacing="" data-w-list-content="">
<p class="zlAe0W_TextBase zlAe0W_Text" data-w-component="text" data-w-wrap="normal">Memory 系统；</p>
</div>
</li>
<li class="v9V1QG_Item" data-w-component="list-item">
<div class="ac5DTa_Box v9V1QG_Content" data-w-direction="col" data-w-auto-spacing="" data-w-list-content="">
<p class="zlAe0W_TextBase zlAe0W_Text" data-w-component="text" data-w-wrap="normal">Skill 能力库。</p>
</div>
</li>
</ul>
<p class="zlAe0W_TextBase zlAe0W_Text" data-w-component="text" data-w-wrap="normal">当用户提出一个复杂业务需求时：</p>
<p class="zlAe0W_TextBase zlAe0W_Text" data-w-component="text" data-w-wrap="normal">A 公司只能给出建议。</p>
<p class="zlAe0W_TextBase zlAe0W_Text" data-w-component="text" data-w-wrap="normal">B 公司不仅能给出建议，还能：</p>
<ul class="Ck6QPa_List" data-w-component="list" data-w-variant="native-unordered">
<li class="v9V1QG_Item" data-w-component="list-item">
<div class="ac5DTa_Box v9V1QG_Content" data-w-direction="col" data-w-auto-spacing="" data-w-list-content="">
<p class="zlAe0W_TextBase zlAe0W_Text" data-w-component="text" data-w-wrap="normal">查询数据；</p>
</div>
</li>
<li class="v9V1QG_Item" data-w-component="list-item">
<div class="ac5DTa_Box v9V1QG_Content" data-w-direction="col" data-w-auto-spacing="" data-w-list-content="">
<p class="zlAe0W_TextBase zlAe0W_Text" data-w-component="text" data-w-wrap="normal">执行流程；</p>
</div>
</li>
<li class="v9V1QG_Item" data-w-component="list-item">
<div class="ac5DTa_Box v9V1QG_Content" data-w-direction="col" data-w-auto-spacing="" data-w-list-content="">
<p class="zlAe0W_TextBase zlAe0W_Text" data-w-component="text" data-w-wrap="normal">生成结果；</p>
</div>
</li>
<li class="v9V1QG_Item" data-w-component="list-item">
<div class="ac5DTa_Box v9V1QG_Content" data-w-direction="col" data-w-auto-spacing="" data-w-list-content="">
<p class="zlAe0W_TextBase zlAe0W_Text" data-w-component="text" data-w-wrap="normal">推动任务完成。</p>
</div>
</li>
</ul>
<p class="zlAe0W_TextBase zlAe0W_Text" data-w-component="text" data-w-wrap="normal">显然，B 公司的 AI 系统更有实际价值。</p>
<p class="zlAe0W_TextBase zlAe0W_Text" data-w-component="text" data-w-wrap="normal">这说明,<span class="zlAe0W_TextBase zlAe0W_Text rFU14q_Emphasis" data-w-component="bold" data-w-default-strong="" data-w-inline="" data-w-wrap="normal">未来的竞争不只是“谁的模型更聪明”，更是“谁能把模型更好地嵌入真实业务系统”。</span></p>
<p class="zlAe0W_TextBase zlAe0W_Text" data-w-component="text" data-w-wrap="normal"><span class="zlAe0W_TextBase zlAe0W_Text rFU14q_Emphasis" data-w-component="bold" data-w-default-strong="" data-w-inline="" data-w-wrap="normal">这也是为什么各大AI公司相继推出了自己的AI Agent 模型代理.</span></p>
<div class="duPRdW_Divider" data-w-component="divider">&nbsp;</div>
<h2 class="XYd-Qa_Headline" data-w-component="title" data-w-weight="semibold" data-w-size="xl">16.4 AI 软件正在发生什么变化？</h2>
<p class="zlAe0W_TextBase zlAe0W_Text" data-w-component="text" data-w-wrap="normal">传统软件通常是：</p>
<div class="relative w-full mt-4 mb-1">
<div class="contents">
<div class="relative">
<div class="h-full min-h-0 min-w-0">
<div class="h-full min-h-0 min-w-0">
<div class="border border-token-border-light border-radius-3xl corner-superellipse/1.1 rounded-3xl">
<div class="h-full w-full border-radius-3xl bg-(--code-block-surface) corner-superellipse/1.1 overflow-clip rounded-3xl [--code-block-surface:var(--bg-elevated-secondary)] dark:[--code-block-surface:var(--composer-surface-primary)] lxnfua_clipPathFallback">
<div class="relative">
<div class="pe-11 pt-3">
<div class="relative z-0 flex max-w-full">
<div id="code-block-viewer" class="q9tKkq_viewer cm-editor z-10 light:cm-light dark:cm-light flex h-full w-full flex-col items-stretch ͼd ͼr" dir="ltr">
<div class="cm-scroller">
<pre class="cm-content q9tKkq_readonly m-0"><code>用户输入
    ↓
固定程序逻辑
    ↓
输出结果</code></pre>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<div>&nbsp;它的特点是：</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<ul class="Ck6QPa_List" data-w-component="list" data-w-variant="native-unordered">
<li class="v9V1QG_Item" data-w-component="list-item">
<div class="ac5DTa_Box v9V1QG_Content" data-w-direction="col" data-w-auto-spacing="" data-w-list-content="">
<p class="zlAe0W_TextBase zlAe0W_Text" data-w-component="text" data-w-wrap="normal">逻辑由开发者提前编写；</p>
</div>
</li>
<li class="v9V1QG_Item" data-w-component="list-item">
<div class="ac5DTa_Box v9V1QG_Content" data-w-direction="col" data-w-auto-spacing="" data-w-list-content="">
<p class="zlAe0W_TextBase zlAe0W_Text" data-w-component="text" data-w-wrap="normal">流程是确定性的；</p>
</div>
</li>
<li class="v9V1QG_Item" data-w-component="list-item">
<div class="ac5DTa_Box v9V1QG_Content" data-w-direction="col" data-w-auto-spacing="" data-w-list-content="">
<p class="zlAe0W_TextBase zlAe0W_Text" data-w-component="text" data-w-wrap="normal">功能边界比较固定。</p>
</div>
</li>
</ul>
<p class="zlAe0W_TextBase zlAe0W_Text" data-w-component="text" data-w-wrap="normal">而 AI Agent 系统更像：</p>
<div class="relative w-full mt-4 mb-1">
<div class="contents">
<div class="relative">
<div class="h-full min-h-0 min-w-0">
<div class="h-full min-h-0 min-w-0">
<div class="border border-token-border-light border-radius-3xl corner-superellipse/1.1 rounded-3xl">
<div class="h-full w-full border-radius-3xl bg-(--code-block-surface) corner-superellipse/1.1 overflow-clip rounded-3xl [--code-block-surface:var(--bg-elevated-secondary)] dark:[--code-block-surface:var(--composer-surface-primary)] lxnfua_clipPathFallback">
<div class="relative">
<div class="pe-11 pt-3">
<div class="relative z-0 flex max-w-full">
<div id="code-block-viewer" class="q9tKkq_viewer cm-editor z-10 light:cm-light dark:cm-light flex h-full w-full flex-col items-stretch ͼd ͼr" dir="ltr">
<div class="cm-scroller">
<pre class="cm-content q9tKkq_readonly m-0"><code>用户目标
    ↓
Agent Runtime
    ↓
LLM 推理
    ↓
Tool / Workflow / Memory / Skill
    ↓
执行结果</code></pre>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<div>&nbsp;它的特点是：</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<ul class="Ck6QPa_List" data-w-component="list" data-w-variant="native-unordered">
<li class="v9V1QG_Item" data-w-component="list-item">
<div class="ac5DTa_Box v9V1QG_Content" data-w-direction="col" data-w-auto-spacing="" data-w-list-content="">
<p class="zlAe0W_TextBase zlAe0W_Text" data-w-component="text" data-w-wrap="normal">用户提供的是目标，而不是精确操作步骤；</p>
</div>
</li>
<li class="v9V1QG_Item" data-w-component="list-item">
<div class="ac5DTa_Box v9V1QG_Content" data-w-direction="col" data-w-auto-spacing="" data-w-list-content="">
<p class="zlAe0W_TextBase zlAe0W_Text" data-w-component="text" data-w-wrap="normal">系统需要动态规划；</p>
</div>
</li>
<li class="v9V1QG_Item" data-w-component="list-item">
<div class="ac5DTa_Box v9V1QG_Content" data-w-direction="col" data-w-auto-spacing="" data-w-list-content="">
<p class="zlAe0W_TextBase zlAe0W_Text" data-w-component="text" data-w-wrap="normal">结果可能来自多次推理和工具调用。</p>
</div>
</li>
</ul>
<p class="zlAe0W_TextBase zlAe0W_Text" data-w-component="text" data-w-wrap="normal">因此，我们可以发现，&nbsp;软件行业正在从<span class="zlAe0W_TextBase zlAe0W_Text rFU14q_Emphasis" data-w-component="bold" data-w-default-strong="" data-w-inline="" data-w-wrap="normal">“功能驱动”&nbsp; 逐步</span>转向<span class="zlAe0W_TextBase zlAe0W_Text rFU14q_Emphasis" data-w-component="bold" data-w-default-strong="" data-w-inline="" data-w-wrap="normal">“目标驱动”。</span></p>
<div class="duPRdW_Divider" data-w-component="divider">&nbsp;</div>
<h2 class="XYd-Qa_Headline" data-w-component="title" data-w-weight="semibold" data-w-size="xl">16.5 未来企业 AI 系统的典型架构</h2>
<p class="zlAe0W_TextBase zlAe0W_Text" data-w-component="text" data-w-wrap="normal">结合前面几章的内容，一个企业级 AI 系统通常会形成这样的结构：</p>
<div class="relative w-full mt-4 mb-1">
<div>
<div class="contents">
<div class="relative">
<div class="h-full min-h-0 min-w-0">
<div class="h-full min-h-0 min-w-0">
<div class="border border-token-border-light border-radius-3xl corner-superellipse/1.1 rounded-3xl">
<div class="h-full w-full border-radius-3xl bg-(--code-block-surface) corner-superellipse/1.1 overflow-clip rounded-3xl [--code-block-surface:var(--bg-elevated-secondary)] dark:[--code-block-surface:var(--composer-surface-primary)] lxnfua_clipPathFallback">
<div class="pointer-events-none absolute end-1.5 top-1 z-2 md:end-2 md:top-1">&nbsp;</div>
<div class="relative">
<div class="pe-11 pt-3">
<div class="relative z-0 flex max-w-full">
<div id="code-block-viewer" class="q9tKkq_viewer cm-editor z-10 light:cm-light dark:cm-light flex h-full w-full flex-col items-stretch ͼd ͼr" dir="ltr">
<div class="cm-scroller">
<pre class="cm-content q9tKkq_readonly m-0"><code>                    用户
                      │
                      ▼
                AI 应用入口
                      │
                      ▼
               Agent Runtime
        ┌───────────┼───────────┐
        ▼           ▼           ▼
     Memory      Workflow     Skill
        │           │           │
        └───────┬───┴───────────┘
                ▼
               LLM
                │
      ┌─────────┴─────────┐
      ▼                   ▼
     MCP              Native Tool
      │
      ▼
数据库 / ERP / 浏览器 / API / 文件系统</code></pre>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<p class="zlAe0W_TextBase zlAe0W_Text" data-w-component="text" data-w-wrap="normal">在这个架构中：</p>
<ul class="Ck6QPa_List" data-w-component="list" data-w-variant="native-unordered">
<li class="v9V1QG_Item" data-w-component="list-item">
<div class="ac5DTa_Box v9V1QG_Content" data-w-direction="col" data-w-auto-spacing="" data-w-list-content="">
<p class="zlAe0W_TextBase zlAe0W_Text" data-w-component="text" data-w-wrap="normal">LLM 提供智能推理；</p>
</div>
</li>
<li class="v9V1QG_Item" data-w-component="list-item">
<div class="ac5DTa_Box v9V1QG_Content" data-w-direction="col" data-w-auto-spacing="" data-w-list-content="">
<p class="zlAe0W_TextBase zlAe0W_Text" data-w-component="text" data-w-wrap="normal">Memory 提供长期知识；</p>
</div>
</li>
<li class="v9V1QG_Item" data-w-component="list-item">
<div class="ac5DTa_Box v9V1QG_Content" data-w-direction="col" data-w-auto-spacing="" data-w-list-content="">
<p class="zlAe0W_TextBase zlAe0W_Text" data-w-component="text" data-w-wrap="normal">Workflow 保证业务流程稳定；</p>
</div>
</li>
<li class="v9V1QG_Item" data-w-component="list-item">
<div class="ac5DTa_Box v9V1QG_Content" data-w-direction="col" data-w-auto-spacing="" data-w-list-content="">
<p class="zlAe0W_TextBase zlAe0W_Text" data-w-component="text" data-w-wrap="normal">Skill 提供专业能力；</p>
</div>
</li>
<li class="v9V1QG_Item" data-w-component="list-item">
<div class="ac5DTa_Box v9V1QG_Content" data-w-direction="col" data-w-auto-spacing="" data-w-list-content="">
<p class="zlAe0W_TextBase zlAe0W_Text" data-w-component="text" data-w-wrap="normal">MCP 统一连接工具；</p>
</div>
</li>
<li class="v9V1QG_Item" data-w-component="list-item">
<div class="ac5DTa_Box v9V1QG_Content" data-w-direction="col" data-w-auto-spacing="" data-w-list-content="">
<p class="zlAe0W_TextBase zlAe0W_Text" data-w-component="text" data-w-wrap="normal">Runtime 负责整体调度。</p>
</div>
</li>
</ul>
<p class="zlAe0W_TextBase zlAe0W_Text" data-w-component="text" data-w-wrap="normal">真正有价值的企业 AI，通常不是某一个单独组件，而是这些组件协同工作的结果。</p>
<div class="duPRdW_Divider" data-w-component="divider">&nbsp;</div>
<h2 class="XYd-Qa_Headline" data-w-component="title" data-w-weight="semibold" data-w-size="xl">16.6 开发者应该如何理解这场变化？</h2>
<p class="zlAe0W_TextBase zlAe0W_Text" data-w-component="text" data-w-wrap="normal">作为我们软件开发者来说，这场变化不仅仅意味着“学习一个新模型”。</p>
<p class="zlAe0W_TextBase zlAe0W_Text" data-w-component="text" data-w-wrap="normal">其实更重要的是,<span class="zlAe0W_TextBase zlAe0W_Text rFU14q_Emphasis" data-w-component="bold" data-w-default-strong="" data-w-inline="" data-w-wrap="normal">软件系统开始具备越来越强的自主决策能力。</span></p>
<p class="zlAe0W_TextBase zlAe0W_Text" data-w-component="text" data-w-wrap="normal">因为这会带来几个明显变化：</p>
<h3 class="XYd-Qa_Headline" data-w-component="title" data-w-weight="semibold" data-w-size="md">第一，Prompt 不再是唯一重点</h3>
<p class="zlAe0W_TextBase zlAe0W_Text" data-w-component="text" data-w-wrap="normal">早期 AI 应用非常依赖 Prompt Engineering。</p>
<p class="zlAe0W_TextBase zlAe0W_Text" data-w-component="text" data-w-wrap="normal">但在 Agent 系统中，Prompt 只是 Skill 和 Runtime 设计的一部分。</p>
<h3 class="XYd-Qa_Headline" data-w-component="title" data-w-weight="semibold" data-w-size="md">第二，系统设计变得更重要</h3>
<p class="zlAe0W_TextBase zlAe0W_Text" data-w-component="text" data-w-wrap="normal">一个成功的 AI Agent，往往取决于：</p>
<ul class="Ck6QPa_List" data-w-component="list" data-w-variant="native-unordered">
<li class="v9V1QG_Item" data-w-component="list-item">
<div class="ac5DTa_Box v9V1QG_Content" data-w-direction="col" data-w-auto-spacing="" data-w-list-content="">
<p class="zlAe0W_TextBase zlAe0W_Text" data-w-component="text" data-w-wrap="normal">Tool 设计；</p>
</div>
</li>
<li class="v9V1QG_Item" data-w-component="list-item">
<div class="ac5DTa_Box v9V1QG_Content" data-w-direction="col" data-w-auto-spacing="" data-w-list-content="">
<p class="zlAe0W_TextBase zlAe0W_Text" data-w-component="text" data-w-wrap="normal">Workflow 编排；</p>
</div>
</li>
<li class="v9V1QG_Item" data-w-component="list-item">
<div class="ac5DTa_Box v9V1QG_Content" data-w-direction="col" data-w-auto-spacing="" data-w-list-content="">
<p class="zlAe0W_TextBase zlAe0W_Text" data-w-component="text" data-w-wrap="normal">Memory 管理；</p>
</div>
</li>
<li class="v9V1QG_Item" data-w-component="list-item">
<div class="ac5DTa_Box v9V1QG_Content" data-w-direction="col" data-w-auto-spacing="" data-w-list-content="">
<p class="zlAe0W_TextBase zlAe0W_Text" data-w-component="text" data-w-wrap="normal">Context 控制；</p>
</div>
</li>
<li class="v9V1QG_Item" data-w-component="list-item">
<div class="ac5DTa_Box v9V1QG_Content" data-w-direction="col" data-w-auto-spacing="" data-w-list-content="">
<p class="zlAe0W_TextBase zlAe0W_Text" data-w-component="text" data-w-wrap="normal">Runtime 调度。</p>
</div>
</li>
</ul>
<p class="zlAe0W_TextBase zlAe0W_Text" data-w-component="text" data-w-wrap="normal">这些都属于软件工程范畴。</p>
<h3 class="XYd-Qa_Headline" data-w-component="title" data-w-weight="semibold" data-w-size="md">第三，业务知识会成为关键资产</h3>
<p class="zlAe0W_TextBase zlAe0W_Text" data-w-component="text" data-w-wrap="normal">通用模型越来越容易获得。</p>
<p class="zlAe0W_TextBase zlAe0W_Text" data-w-component="text" data-w-wrap="normal">但企业自己的：</p>
<ul class="Ck6QPa_List" data-w-component="list" data-w-variant="native-unordered">
<li class="v9V1QG_Item" data-w-component="list-item">
<div class="ac5DTa_Box v9V1QG_Content" data-w-direction="col" data-w-auto-spacing="" data-w-list-content="">
<p class="zlAe0W_TextBase zlAe0W_Text" data-w-component="text" data-w-wrap="normal">业务流程；</p>
</div>
</li>
<li class="v9V1QG_Item" data-w-component="list-item">
<div class="ac5DTa_Box v9V1QG_Content" data-w-direction="col" data-w-auto-spacing="" data-w-list-content="">
<p class="zlAe0W_TextBase zlAe0W_Text" data-w-component="text" data-w-wrap="normal">数据结构；</p>
</div>
</li>
<li class="v9V1QG_Item" data-w-component="list-item">
<div class="ac5DTa_Box v9V1QG_Content" data-w-direction="col" data-w-auto-spacing="" data-w-list-content="">
<p class="zlAe0W_TextBase zlAe0W_Text" data-w-component="text" data-w-wrap="normal">历史知识；</p>
</div>
</li>
<li class="v9V1QG_Item" data-w-component="list-item">
<div class="ac5DTa_Box v9V1QG_Content" data-w-direction="col" data-w-auto-spacing="" data-w-list-content="">
<p class="zlAe0W_TextBase zlAe0W_Text" data-w-component="text" data-w-wrap="normal">规则体系；</p>
</div>
</li>
</ul>
<p class="zlAe0W_TextBase zlAe0W_Text" data-w-component="text" data-w-wrap="normal">其实这才是结合 AI 真正发挥价值的地方。</p>
<div class="duPRdW_Divider" data-w-component="divider">&nbsp;</div>
<h2 class="XYd-Qa_Headline" data-w-component="title" data-w-weight="semibold" data-w-size="xl">16.7 一个重要趋势：AI 不再只是“功能”，而是“系统能力”</h2>
<p class="zlAe0W_TextBase zlAe0W_Text" data-w-component="text" data-w-wrap="normal">未来的软件可能会越来越像这样：</p>
<div class="relative w-full mt-4 mb-1">
<div class="contents">
<div class="relative">
<div class="h-full min-h-0 min-w-0">
<div class="h-full min-h-0 min-w-0">
<div class="border border-token-border-light border-radius-3xl corner-superellipse/1.1 rounded-3xl">
<div class="h-full w-full border-radius-3xl bg-(--code-block-surface) corner-superellipse/1.1 overflow-clip rounded-3xl [--code-block-surface:var(--bg-elevated-secondary)] dark:[--code-block-surface:var(--composer-surface-primary)] lxnfua_clipPathFallback">
<div class="relative">
<div class="pe-11 pt-3">
<div class="relative z-0 flex max-w-full">
<div id="code-block-viewer" class="q9tKkq_viewer cm-editor z-10 light:cm-light dark:cm-light flex h-full w-full flex-col items-stretch ͼd ͼr" dir="ltr">
<div class="cm-scroller">
<pre class="cm-content q9tKkq_readonly m-0"><code>提出目标
    ↓
Agent 规划步骤
    ↓
调用工具
    ↓
执行流程
    ↓
持续反馈
    ↓
完成目标</code></pre>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<div>&nbsp;也就是说：<strong><span class="zlAe0W_TextBase zlAe0W_Text rFU14q_Emphasis" data-w-component="bold" data-w-default-strong="" data-w-inline="" data-w-wrap="normal">AI 不再只是软件中的一个功能模块，而会逐渐成为软件系统的核心交互方式。</span></strong></div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<p class="zlAe0W_TextBase zlAe0W_Text" data-w-component="text" data-w-wrap="normal">&nbsp;</p>
<div class="duPRdW_Divider" data-w-component="divider">&nbsp;</div>
<h2 class="XYd-Qa_Headline" data-w-component="title" data-w-weight="semibold" data-w-size="xl">16.8 回顾全系列：从 Token 到 Agent</h2>
<p class="zlAe0W_TextBase zlAe0W_Text" data-w-component="text" data-w-wrap="normal">现在，我们可以回顾我们整个系列的逻辑。</p>
<p class="zlAe0W_TextBase zlAe0W_Text" data-w-component="text" data-w-wrap="normal">其实我们这个系列,可以算是分成了2个部分.</p>
<h3 class="XYd-Qa_Headline" data-w-component="title" data-w-weight="semibold" data-w-size="md">第一部分：模型如何思考</h3>
<ul class="Ck6QPa_List" data-w-component="list" data-w-variant="native-unordered">
<li class="v9V1QG_Item" data-w-component="list-item">
<div class="ac5DTa_Box v9V1QG_Content" data-w-direction="col" data-w-auto-spacing="" data-w-list-content="">
<p class="zlAe0W_TextBase zlAe0W_Text" data-w-component="text" data-w-wrap="normal">什么是文字接龙；</p>
</div>
</li>
<li class="v9V1QG_Item" data-w-component="list-item">
<div class="ac5DTa_Box v9V1QG_Content" data-w-direction="col" data-w-auto-spacing="" data-w-list-content="">
<p class="zlAe0W_TextBase zlAe0W_Text" data-w-component="text" data-w-wrap="normal">Token、Tokenizer、Vocabulary；</p>
</div>
</li>
<li class="v9V1QG_Item" data-w-component="list-item">
<div class="ac5DTa_Box v9V1QG_Content" data-w-direction="col" data-w-auto-spacing="" data-w-list-content="">
<p class="zlAe0W_TextBase zlAe0W_Text" data-w-component="text" data-w-wrap="normal">Embedding；</p>
</div>
</li>
<li class="v9V1QG_Item" data-w-component="list-item">
<div class="ac5DTa_Box v9V1QG_Content" data-w-direction="col" data-w-auto-spacing="" data-w-list-content="">
<p class="zlAe0W_TextBase zlAe0W_Text" data-w-component="text" data-w-wrap="normal">Attention；</p>
</div>
</li>
<li class="v9V1QG_Item" data-w-component="list-item">
<div class="ac5DTa_Box v9V1QG_Content" data-w-direction="col" data-w-auto-spacing="" data-w-list-content="">
<p class="zlAe0W_TextBase zlAe0W_Text" data-w-component="text" data-w-wrap="normal">Transformer；</p>
</div>
</li>
<li class="v9V1QG_Item" data-w-component="list-item">
<div class="ac5DTa_Box v9V1QG_Content" data-w-direction="col" data-w-auto-spacing="" data-w-list-content="">
<p class="zlAe0W_TextBase zlAe0W_Text" data-w-component="text" data-w-wrap="normal">FFN、SwiGLU、MoE；</p>
</div>
</li>
<li class="v9V1QG_Item" data-w-component="list-item">
<div class="ac5DTa_Box v9V1QG_Content" data-w-direction="col" data-w-auto-spacing="" data-w-list-content="">
<p class="zlAe0W_TextBase zlAe0W_Text" data-w-component="text" data-w-wrap="normal">训练方式；</p>
</div>
</li>
<li class="v9V1QG_Item" data-w-component="list-item">
<div class="ac5DTa_Box v9V1QG_Content" data-w-direction="col" data-w-auto-spacing="" data-w-list-content="">
<p class="zlAe0W_TextBase zlAe0W_Text" data-w-component="text" data-w-wrap="normal">Next Token Prediction；</p>
</div>
</li>
<li class="v9V1QG_Item" data-w-component="list-item">
<div class="ac5DTa_Box v9V1QG_Content" data-w-direction="col" data-w-auto-spacing="" data-w-list-content="">
<p class="zlAe0W_TextBase zlAe0W_Text" data-w-component="text" data-w-wrap="normal">幻觉机制。</p>
</div>
</li>
</ul>
<p class="zlAe0W_TextBase zlAe0W_Text" data-w-component="text" data-w-wrap="normal">这些解释了：<span class="zlAe0W_TextBase zlAe0W_Text rFU14q_Emphasis" data-w-component="bold" data-w-default-strong="" data-w-inline="" data-w-wrap="normal">LLM 为什么能够表现出智能。</span></p>
<div class="duPRdW_Divider" data-w-component="divider">&nbsp;</div>
<h3 class="XYd-Qa_Headline" data-w-component="title" data-w-weight="semibold" data-w-size="md">第二部分：AI 如何做事</h3>
<ul class="Ck6QPa_List" data-w-component="list" data-w-variant="native-unordered">
<li class="v9V1QG_Item" data-w-component="list-item">
<div class="ac5DTa_Box v9V1QG_Content" data-w-direction="col" data-w-auto-spacing="" data-w-list-content="">
<p class="zlAe0W_TextBase zlAe0W_Text" data-w-component="text" data-w-wrap="normal">为什么需要 Agent；</p>
</div>
</li>
<li class="v9V1QG_Item" data-w-component="list-item">
<div class="ac5DTa_Box v9V1QG_Content" data-w-direction="col" data-w-auto-spacing="" data-w-list-content="">
<p class="zlAe0W_TextBase zlAe0W_Text" data-w-component="text" data-w-wrap="normal">Tool Calling；</p>
</div>
</li>
<li class="v9V1QG_Item" data-w-component="list-item">
<div class="ac5DTa_Box v9V1QG_Content" data-w-direction="col" data-w-auto-spacing="" data-w-list-content="">
<p class="zlAe0W_TextBase zlAe0W_Text" data-w-component="text" data-w-wrap="normal">MCP；</p>
</div>
</li>
<li class="v9V1QG_Item" data-w-component="list-item">
<div class="ac5DTa_Box v9V1QG_Content" data-w-direction="col" data-w-auto-spacing="" data-w-list-content="">
<p class="zlAe0W_TextBase zlAe0W_Text" data-w-component="text" data-w-wrap="normal">Workflow；</p>
</div>
</li>
<li class="v9V1QG_Item" data-w-component="list-item">
<div class="ac5DTa_Box v9V1QG_Content" data-w-direction="col" data-w-auto-spacing="" data-w-list-content="">
<p class="zlAe0W_TextBase zlAe0W_Text" data-w-component="text" data-w-wrap="normal">Memory；</p>
</div>
</li>
<li class="v9V1QG_Item" data-w-component="list-item">
<div class="ac5DTa_Box v9V1QG_Content" data-w-direction="col" data-w-auto-spacing="" data-w-list-content="">
<p class="zlAe0W_TextBase zlAe0W_Text" data-w-component="text" data-w-wrap="normal">Skill；</p>
</div>
</li>
<li class="v9V1QG_Item" data-w-component="list-item">
<div class="ac5DTa_Box v9V1QG_Content" data-w-direction="col" data-w-auto-spacing="" data-w-list-content="">
<p class="zlAe0W_TextBase zlAe0W_Text" data-w-component="text" data-w-wrap="normal">Agent Runtime。</p>
</div>
</li>
</ul>
<p class="zlAe0W_TextBase zlAe0W_Text" data-w-component="text" data-w-wrap="normal">这一部分解释了：<span class="zlAe0W_TextBase zlAe0W_Text rFU14q_Emphasis" data-w-component="bold" data-w-default-strong="" data-w-inline="" data-w-wrap="normal">LLM 如何从“会思考”变成“能完成任务”。</span></p>
<div class="duPRdW_Divider" data-w-component="divider">最终本系列形成了一个完整闭环：</div>
<div class="relative w-full mt-4 mb-1">
<div class="contents">
<div class="relative">
<div class="h-full min-h-0 min-w-0">
<div class="h-full min-h-0 min-w-0">
<div class="border border-token-border-light border-radius-3xl corner-superellipse/1.1 rounded-3xl">
<div class="h-full w-full border-radius-3xl bg-(--code-block-surface) corner-superellipse/1.1 overflow-clip rounded-3xl [--code-block-surface:var(--bg-elevated-secondary)] dark:[--code-block-surface:var(--composer-surface-primary)] lxnfua_clipPathFallback">
<div class="relative">
<div class="pe-11 pt-3">
<div class="relative z-0 flex max-w-full">
<div id="code-block-viewer" class="q9tKkq_viewer cm-editor z-10 light:cm-light dark:cm-light flex h-full w-full flex-col items-stretch ͼd ͼr" dir="ltr">
<div class="cm-scroller">
<pre class="cm-content q9tKkq_readonly m-0"><code>Token
    ↓
LLM
    ↓
Reasoning
    ↓
Tool Calling
    ↓
MCP
    ↓
Workflow
    ↓
Memory
    ↓
Skill
    ↓
Agent Runtime
    ↓
Autonomous Agent</code></pre>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<h2 class="XYd-Qa_Headline" data-w-component="title" data-w-weight="semibold" data-w-size="lg">系列结语</h2>
<p class="zlAe0W_TextBase zlAe0W_Text" data-w-component="text" data-w-wrap="normal">从最开始的 Token，到最终的 Agent Runtime，我们总结了一下AI从开始到现在的技术演进路线：</p>
<ul class="Ck6QPa_List" data-w-component="list" data-w-variant="native-unordered">
<li class="v9V1QG_Item" data-w-component="list-item">
<div class="ac5DTa_Box v9V1QG_Content" data-w-direction="col" data-w-auto-spacing="" data-w-list-content="">
<p class="zlAe0W_TextBase zlAe0W_Text" data-w-component="text" data-w-wrap="normal">大模型让机器具备了理解和生成语言的能力；</p>
</div>
</li>
<li class="v9V1QG_Item" data-w-component="list-item">
<div class="ac5DTa_Box v9V1QG_Content" data-w-direction="col" data-w-auto-spacing="" data-w-list-content="">
<p class="zlAe0W_TextBase zlAe0W_Text" data-w-component="text" data-w-wrap="normal">Tool 和 MCP 让 AI 能够连接现实世界；</p>
</div>
</li>
<li class="v9V1QG_Item" data-w-component="list-item">
<div class="ac5DTa_Box v9V1QG_Content" data-w-direction="col" data-w-auto-spacing="" data-w-list-content="">
<p class="zlAe0W_TextBase zlAe0W_Text" data-w-component="text" data-w-wrap="normal">Workflow、Memory 和 Skill 让 AI 能够适应企业业务；</p>
</div>
</li>
<li class="v9V1QG_Item" data-w-component="list-item">
<div class="ac5DTa_Box v9V1QG_Content" data-w-direction="col" data-w-auto-spacing="" data-w-list-content="">
<p class="zlAe0W_TextBase zlAe0W_Text" data-w-component="text" data-w-wrap="normal">Agent Runtime 则让这些能力形成一个持续运行的智能系统。</p>
</div>
</li>
</ul>
<p class="zlAe0W_TextBase zlAe0W_Text" data-w-component="text" data-w-wrap="normal">所以,未来的软件开发,可能也不再只是“编写功能代码”，而是需要<span class="zlAe0W_TextBase zlAe0W_Text rFU14q_Emphasis" data-w-component="bold" data-w-default-strong="" data-w-inline="" data-w-wrap="normal">设计能够理解目标、调用能力、管理状态并持续完成任务的智能系统。</span></p>
<p class="zlAe0W_TextBase zlAe0W_Text" data-w-component="text" data-w-wrap="normal">这其实也正是 AI Agent 时代最重要的变化。</p>
<p class="zlAe0W_TextBase zlAe0W_Text" data-w-component="text" data-w-wrap="normal">写到这里,本系列就结束了.</p>
<p class="zlAe0W_TextBase zlAe0W_Text" data-w-component="text" data-w-wrap="normal">这里也感谢很多兄弟的支持和指正.</p>
<p class="zlAe0W_TextBase zlAe0W_Text" data-w-component="text" data-w-wrap="normal"><strong>本篇只代表个人对于AI未来的一些畅想,有不同意见的兄弟 也欢迎讨论</strong></p>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
